newsitem.title: USA: 39 dead in apparent mass suicide outside San Diego.
newsitem.headline: 39 dead in apparent mass suicide outside San Diego.

text.p: Deputies found 39 men dead at the scene of an apparent mass suicide in a luxury mansion, the San Diego Sheriff's Department said on Wednesday.
Capt. Alan Fulmer told reporters the men were all similarly dressed and there was no blood or sign of trauma at the scene in Rancho Santa Fe, some 20 miles (32 km) north of San Diego.
